title: IcedSpear
description: Your all-in-one map management system allowing you to have custom map lobbies, friends, partys, leaderboards and speedrun timers with ease.
body:
# IcedSpear

**Your all-in-one map management system.**

IcedSpear is a powerful core plugin designed for parkour servers like [FragMC](https://fragmc.github.io), providing advanced map instance management, a robust party system, and competitive features like leaderboards and timers. Whether you're running a parkour server, a minigame network, or a practice lobby, IcedSpear handles the heavy lifting of world management so you can focus on the gameplay.

## ✨ Features

*   **🗺️ Advanced Map Management**
    Create public, private, and party-exclusive map instances on the fly. IcedSpear handles automatic world generation, schematic loading, and cleanup, ensuring a fresh experience for every session.

*   **👥 Robust Party System**
    Keep your players together. The built-in party system supports invites, private chat, and leader-controlled warping, making it easy for friends to play together.

*   **🏆 Leaderboards & Stats**
    Foster competition with global and instance-specific leaderboards. Track best times, completions, and other statistics automatically.

*   **🧩 Official Addons**
    Many addons exist and are in development by our team for IcedSpear.

*   **⚡ High Performance**
    Optimized for Paper/Spigot 1.21+, IcedSpear uses asynchronous world handling to ensure your server stays lag-free, even under load.

*   **🛠️ Developer Friendly API**
    Built with extensibility in mind. The extensive API allows developers to create custom game modes, GUIs, and deep integrations with other plugins.

## 🚀 Installation

1.  Download the latest JAR from the versions tab.
2.  Place the jar files into your server's `plugins` folder.
3.  Restart your server.
4.  Follow the [Configuration Guide](https://fragmc.github.io/Icedspear/core/configuration.html) to get started

## 📚 Documentation

Full documentation, including configuration guides, permission nodes, and API usage, is available on our **[Official Wiki](https://fragmc.github.io/Icedspear/)**.

*   **Source Code**: [GitHub](https://github.com/FragMC/Icedspear)
